Metadata.title: Root Access
Metadata.description: Build better Startup Proposals with AI, step by step.

welcome.title: Welcome to Root Access
welcome.description: Root Access helps you improve how you use AI for a Startup Proposal, one focused section at a time. You stay in control of the thinking and final writing.
welcome.accomplishBody: A stronger proposal section, clear weaknesses, and a better prompt for the next attempt.
welcome.timeBody: About one minute for this tour; then choose which section to create, review, or improve.
welcome.workflowBody: Add context → create output → review → improve when needed → export a draft.

tour.completeCurrentAction: Complete the highlighted action first, then select Next.

projectForm.title: Start with useful project context
projectForm.body: Describe the startup idea, industry, and target customer. Root Access keeps this context consistent across the proposal.
projectForm.helper: Specific context produces more relevant prompts and more accurate review feedback.

generateWorkflow.title: Open the step-by-step workspace
generateWorkflow.body: Submit your context to start the first section. The tour resumes once the workspace opens.
generateWorkflow.helper: Each section has three clear steps: create output, review it, and improve when needed.

workspace.title: Create a guided output
workspace.body: Check the instructions for the current section, edit them if needed, then select Create output. You can still edit the output before reviewing it.
workspace.helper: This creates working material only; you do not need to trust or use an AI answer as-is.

review.title: Review the AI output
review.body: Select Review my work to check six business criteria and see evidence for strengths, weaknesses, and missing facts.
review.helper: Review turns an AI answer into something you can verify rather than content you accept blindly.

improve.title: Improve only when feedback makes it useful
improve.body: Create a better instruction from the weaknesses found, or keep the current output and move to the next section.
improve.helper: There are no hidden AI calls: Root Access uses another AI request only when you select Improve prompt.

export.title: Export a draft when it is useful
export.body: The Export current draft button becomes available as soon as there is content, so you can export TXT, DOCX, or PDF before every section is complete.
export.helper: Always verify facts, add your reasoning, and rewrite the final submission in your own voice.

waiting.title: Tour paused at the workspace step
waiting.body: Add your context and select Start proposal review. The tour will resume on the create-output screen.

onboarding.title: Use AI as a study assistant, not a submission shortcut
onboarding.body: Root Access helps with planning, outlining, research direction, and drafting prompts. It does not replace your original work, guarantee correctness, or encourage direct submission of AI output.

workflow.title: Review every AI output before it becomes your proposal
workflow.body: Use these prompts to create working material. Verify facts and sources, add your own reasoning, and rewrite the output in your voice before submitting anything.

FooterDisclaimer.body: Academic integrity: Root Access supports planning, outlining, research, and drafting. Verify sources, add your own analysis, and do not submit AI output as final work.
